Method of Attack: Phishing campaigns leveraging malicious Microsoft OneNote files to spread AsyncRAT malware
Process hollowing to implant AsyncRAT client into the target process notepad.exe
Fileless malware techniques to evade detection
Anti-analysis techniques such as overriding AmsiScanBuffer() and checking for debuggers
Attack Vector: Phishing email disguised as an urgent shipment notification with a malicious Microsoft OneNote file attachment
Execution of BAT files embedded in the OneNote file to download and execute malicious payloads
